channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Amphithere: Winged Serpent
item.description: Adds an amphithere dragon species to the world.

item.title: Animalica - Body Tools & Classes
item.description: Wearable body tools and universal classes for Animalica player species.

item.title: Hex's Mechworks
item.description: The factory must grow!

item.title: Fablewood Harmony Patches
item.description: Harmony patches for compatibility.

item.title: SimpleCloth Compatibility Patches
item.description: A collection of patches for SimpleCloth Updated and Tailor's Delight, Wool & More, and Butchering.

item.title: SheyderMod
item.description: A simple SheyderMod that supports the original artstyle of the game.

item.title: The Almanac: Trades, Callings & Mastery
item.description: Twenty-one trades, Novice to Grandmaster, earned by the work of your hands, not by grinding.

item.title: The Quire Patches
item.description: Cohesion patches and a pack guide that keep the Almanac's loaded mod set seamless.

item.title: Real Smoke & QP's Chisel Tools Compatibility Patch 1.22
item.description: Adds compatibility between Real Smoke and QP Chisel Tools decorative blocks.

item.title: Simple Voice Chat
item.description: General voice chat mod with proximity voice, custom channels, audio processing, and permissions.

item.description: Seal a room, light the iron stove, splash a watering can over the hot stones, and you have a sauna

item.description: Adds a variety of storage blocks designed for both aesthetic appeal and functional item organization

item.title: Boat Autopilot
item.description: Long boat trips in Vintage Story are beautiful… the first three times.

item.title: IndustrialStory
item.description: Overhauls metalworking, chemistry, and glassworking.

item.title: Olendril Toolsmith and IME Compat Patch
item.description: Toolsmith Interesting Mining and Extraction Compatibility

item.title: The Crown & The Coalition Server Tweaks
item.description: Server tweaks for The Crown & The Coalition.

item.title: Auto Walk Extended
item.description: Toggle walking/running. Options for sneak toggle, stepup and mouse button lock.

item.title: Meliora Meadows Adjustments

item.title: Tile 'n All
item.description: Spicing up the bathroom floor? Redecorating the kitchen? look no further, friend.

item.title: Claytile backport (1.22 -> 1.21)
item.description: [Sloppy ceramic noises]

item.title: Ecosystem - Flora
item.description: Making flora living

item.title: RLMoonSun
item.description: Changes the texture from the sun and moon to a more realistic one.

item.title: BetterTraders
item.description: Replaces vanilla traders with new trader structures.
